q1_issues.issue: The restrictive post-modifier is predicated of the group individual, (Related sk_activities_1 prostitution), instead of distributing over its members as a descriptive plural modifier must, so no individual activity is derivably related to prostitution.
The flat twin (Inheritance prostitution illegal) drops the Canada restriction and so asserts the kind-level claim unrestrictedly, which is not what the sentence says.

q2_gaps: concessive / contrastive "while" — "while" is listed only among the TEMPORAL connectives that get no connective atom, yet here it states a contrast, which the connective rule would capture surface-faithfully as (While main sub)
a locative PP restricting a kind-denoting NP ("prostitution in Canada" as subject) — no rule attaches a place to a bare kind, so the PP has to be re-attached to the predicate

a participial / adjectival post-modifier taking a PP complement ("activities related to prostitution") — the reduced-relative rule demands an event form and forbids a participle-named head, while the symmetric-predicate license would give (Related …) + (Symmetric Related)
notes: The partitive "most of the activities" is textbook-correct — definite superset, subset with SubsetOf and ProportionOf most, and Inheritance (not Member) for the subset's property. Reifying both clauses as Experiencer state witnesses plus their flat twins is licensed only because a connective atom is emitted, and the (While sk_legal_1 sk_illegal_1) argument order (main clause first) is right.
